branch_by_position.why: Hranečník loop is at about 18.318 E. Only the battery branches (101 Radvanice, 107 Bartovice) run east of it.

who_text: DPO works its trolleybuses in cross-line duties: a course of the 1xx group runs on 101, 106 and 107 in turn, the 2xx group on 102, 103, 105, 108 and 109, and the articulated 8xx group on 104 with a few 101 trips. Seznam-autobusu records such moves as 'přejezd na linku …' (moves to line …). Simutrans cannot change a vehicle's line, so each bus is placed on the line it was working at the peak, which is the line of its first live sighting between 16:29 and 16:50.
branches_why: Lines 101 and 107 each have a branch under the wire to Hranečník and a battery branch beyond it (101 to Radvanice, Ludvíkova every 30 min; 107 to Bartovice, Ještěrka every 20 min). The branches have different termini and different headways, and a route cannot change with 'Also at', so each branch is its own Simutrans line (A = Hranečník, B = battery branch). The real minutes are kept, so they interleave on the shared section as in the timetable. A bus seen east of Hranečník between 16:29 and 17:15 is on the battery branch.
interlining: At the peak each bus stays on one line long enough to be placed, but the duties hand buses between lines at shared termini: 107 to Hranečník ends at 16:33 and those buses continue as 101, and 105 buses continue as 103 at Koblov. The depot table shows each bus's later lines. No Simutrans line spans two DPO lines.
network_state: Long-term: 101 to Radvanice and 107 to Bartovice run beyond the wire from Hranečník, and all of line 106 crosses the unwired Dědičná – Michálkovická stretch by Všehrdův sad. New wire there is planned but not built. See Battery sections.
From 17 Sep 2026, during the interchange rebuild, lines 103 and 104 board at the provisional stop Náměstí Republiky C on Českobratrská street. Routes and running times are as in the timetable.
5–16 Oct 2026: one direction was diverted via Jaklovecká and Stadion Bazaly. It was short-term and has ended (checked 20 Oct 2026), so line 106 keeps its regular route.
Night trolleybus lines, not in the afternoon peak.

line_notes.101: Two Simutrans lines: 101A Hlavní nádraží – Hranečník (:00 :20 :30 :50 from Hlavní nádraží) and 101B to Radvanice, Ludvíkova on battery beyond Hranečník (:10 :40). Together they give a 10-minute trunk. The 27Tr courses 801/802 come from the 104 duty group.
line_notes.102: Every 10 min: Hlavní nádraží – Přívoz – Nová radnice – Českobratrská – Mariánské Hory – Hulváky, the direct route.
line_notes.103: Every 20 min to Koblov. Its duties also work line 105.
line_notes.104: The articulated line: Škoda 27Tr Solaris, every 10 min, Náměstí Republiky – Stadion Bazaly – Michálkovice.
line_notes.105: Every 20 min, Karolina U lávky – Koblov; buses continue as 103 at Koblov.
line_notes.106: Every 10 min, all on battery trolleybuses because of the unwired stretch by Všehrdův sad.
line_notes.107: Two Simutrans lines: 107A sídliště Fifejdy – Hranečník (under the wire, until 16:33 from Hranečník) and 107B to Bartovice, Ještěrka on battery beyond Hranečník, each every 20 min and interleaved to 10 min.
line_notes.108: Every 20 min: a long semicircle from Hulváky via Mariánské Hory, sídliště Fifejdy, the centre, Stadion Bazaly and Muglinov to Hlavní nádraží (about 38 min against 102's 24).
line_notes.109: Every 20 min: Heřmanice, Důl Heřmanice – Hrušov – Muglinov – Stadion Bazaly – centre (Husův sad) – sídliště Fifejdy – Mariánské Hory – Hulváky.
